So he spent 99% of $5 = $4.95. But he also spent money on chips and candy bars. So the total cost of chips + candy bars = $4.95. But we also know he bought 3 chips for $1.20. So cost of candy bars = $4.95 - $1.20 = $3.75. Each candy bar costs $0.75. So number of candy bars = $3.75 / $0.75 = 5. So answer: 5 candy bars.

Check: 5 candy bars cost 5 * 0.75 = $3.75. Chips cost $1.20. Total $4.95. He kept 1% of $5 = $0.05. So total $5. Yes.

Thus answer: 5.
